newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Stals says may cut rates later in the year.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Stals says may cut rates later in the year.

text.p: South Africa's Reserve bank Governor Chris Stals said on Tuesday that any interest cuts would come later in the year not sooner.
"Maybe interest rates can decline, but later in the year with the emphasis on later," he told reporters at a media briefing.
South Africa's prime interest rate is 20.25 percent, while the bank rate stands at 17.0 percent. The last interest rate hike was on November 21, 1996.
